Severity scan on pair0: speckle:1 sigma diff 67% -> speckle:2 33% -> speckle:3 MATCH (monotone). 5-pair support validation of noise_speckle:3+compression_jpeg:2: MATCH 3/3 on ALL 5 pairs (R0 gaussian_RGB:2 was MATCH/PARTIAL/MATCH/WEAK/WEAK; pairs 1,3,4 improved to MATCH, no regression). Under speckle:3, block_boundary matched <8% on all 5 pairs, showing R0's 9%/13% bb diffs on pairs 3/4 were caused by wrong noise statistics, not wrong JPEG severity. JPEG:2 unchanged (block_boundary=1.557 0%FP; R0 sweep sev3=20%, sev4=56%). Blur absent (gm_ratio=1.087, slope_ratio=0.989; R0 blur_gaussian:1 control worsened 2 signals). Global absent (variance_ratio=0.919, mean_shift=-0.0031; minimum global severities are far stronger: contrast_weaken_scale:1 -> var ratio ~0.56, darken_gamma:1 -> mean shift << -0.003, contrast_weaken_stretch:1 is identity). chroma_ratio=0.921 also argues against YCrCb noise. sigma>2 -> PSNR unusable and noise step never LIKELY; both steps UNCERTAIN per verdict rules.
